verses.text: <pb/><t>Tonu Ja.</t> <t>Kelenu Jehova; n'ihi na Ọ di nma:</t> <t>N'ihi na rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi ka ebere-Ya di.</t>
<t>Ònye gākọ akukọ idi-ike nile nke Jehova?</t> <t>Ònye gēme ka anuru otuto-Ya nile?</t>
<t>Ndi ihe nāgara nke-ọma ka ndi nēdebe ikpé bu,</t> <t>Ha na onye nēme ezi omume na mb͕e nile.</t>
<t>Chetam, Jehova, were ka ihe ndi-gi si atọ Gi utọ chetam;</t> <t>Were nzọputa-Gi letam:</t>
<t>Ka m'we lekwasi ọdi-nma nke ndi I rọputaworo,</t> <t>Ka m'we ṅuria n'ọṅù mba-Gi,</t> <t>Ka m'we soro ihe-nketa-Gi nya isi.</t>
<t>Ayi esowo nna-ayi-hà mehie,</t> <t>Ayi emewo ajọ omume, ayi emebiwo iwu.</t>
<t>Nna-ayi-hà enweghi uche ighọta oké ọlu-Gi nile n'Ijipt;</t> <t>Ha echetaghi iba-uba nke ebere-Gi nile;</t> <t>Ha we nupu isi n'akuku oké osimiri, bú n'Oké Osimiri Uhie.</t>
<t>Ma Ọ zọputara ha n'ihi aha-Ya,</t> <t>Ime ka amara idi-ike-Ya.</t>
<t>O we basiere Oké Osimiri Uhue nba, o we tasia:</t> <t>O we me ka ha nēje ije n'ob͕u-miri-ya nile dika ọ bu ọzara.</t>
<t>O we zọputa ha n'aka onye nākpọ ha asì,</t> <t>B͕aputa kwa ha n'aka onye-iro-ha.</t>
<t>Miri we kpuchie ndi nākpab͕u ha:</t> <t>Ọ dighi otù onye nime ha fọduru.</t>
<t>Ha we kwere okwu-Ya nile;</t> <t>Ha nābù abù otuto-Ya.</t>
<t>Ha chezọrọ ọlu-Ya nile ngwa ngwa;</t> <t>Ha echeghi ndum-ọdu-Ya:</t>
<t>Ha we chọ ajọ ọchichọ n'ọzara,</t> <t>We nwa Chineke n'ala tọb͕ọrọ n'efu.</t>
<t>O we nye ha ihe ha riọrọ;</t> <t>Ma O zitere aru-ọtita na nkpuru-obi-ha.</t>
<t>Ha kwo-kwa-ra Moses ekworo n'ọmuma-ulo-ikwū-ha,</t> <t>Kwo kwa Eron, bú onye nsọ nke Jehova.</t>
<t>Ala nēmeghe, we loda Detan,</t> <t>Kpuchi kwa nzukọ Abairam.</t>
<t>Ọku we nēre n'etiti nzukọ-ha;</t> <t>Ire-ọku nērepia ndi nēmebi iwu.</t>
<t>Ha nēme nwa-ehi na Horeb,</t> <t>We kpọ isi ala nye ihe awuru awu.</t>
<t>Ha we b͕anwe nsọpuru-ha</t> <t>N'ihe-atù nke ehi nāta ihe akuru n'ala.</t>
<t>Ha chezọrọ Chineke, bú Onye-nzọputa-ha,</t> <t>Onye nēmeri ihe uku di iche iche n'Ijipt;</t>
<t>Oké ọlu di iche iche n'ala Ham,</t> <t>Na ihe di egwu di iche iche n'akuku Oké Osimiri Uhie.</t>
<t>O we si na O gēkpochapu ha,</t> <t>Ma ọ buru na Moses, bú onye Ọ rọputaworo, eguzoghi na ntiwa ahu n'iru Ya,</t> <t>Ime ka ọnuma-Ya si n'ibibi ha laghachi.</t>
<t>Ọzọ, ha juru ala anāchọsi ike,</t> <t>Ha ekweghi okwu-Ya;</t>
<t>Ha we tamu n'ulo-ikwū nile ha,</t> <t>Ha egeghi nti n'olu Jehova.</t>
<t>O we welie aka-Ya elu n'ebe ha nọ,</t> <t>Ime ka ha da n'ọzara:</t>
<t>Na ime ka nkpuru-ha da n'etiti mba nile,</t> <t>Na ichusa ha n'ala nile.</t>
<t>Ha kekọta-kwa-ra onwe-ha n'aru Beal-peoa,</t> <t>We rie àjà nile nke ihe nwuru anwu.</t>
<t>Ha we were omume nile ha kpasue Ya iwe:</t> <t>Ihe-otiti we dakwasi ha.</t>
<t>Finehas wee guzo ọtọ, me ihe ekpere n'ikpe:</t> <t>Ewe b͕ochi ihe-otiti ahu.</t>
<t>Ewe guara ya nka n'ezi omume,</t> <t>Rue ọb͕ọ nile rua mb͕e ebighi-ebi.</t>
<t>Ha kpasu-kwa-ra Ya iwe na miri Meriba,</t> <t>O we jọrọ Moses njọ n'ihi ha:</t>
<t>N'ihi na ha nupuru isi n'okpuru Mọ-Ya,</t> <t>O we were eb͕ub͕ere-ọnu-ya abua kwue okwu efu.</t>
<t>Ha ekpochapughi ndi di iche iche ahu,</t> <t>Dika Jehova siri ha;</t>
<t>Ma ha gwakọtara onwe-ha na mba nile nke ala ahu,</t> <t>We muta ọlu nile ha:</t>
<t>Ha we fè arusi nile ha òfùfè;</t> <t>Arusi ahu we ghọrọ ha ọnyà:</t>
<t>Ọzọ, ha were umu-ha ndikom na umu-ha ndinyom chuara ndi-mọ ọjọ àjà,</t>
<t>We wusi ọbara nke nēmeghi ihe ọjọ, bú ọbara nke umu-ha ndikom na umu-ha ndinyom,</t> <t>Ndi ha were chuara arusi nile nke Kenean àjà;</t> <t>Ewe were ọbara merua ala ahu.</t>
<t>Ewe were ọlu nile ha me ka ha buru ihe ruru árú,</t> <t>Ha we nākwa iko n'omume nile ha.</t>
<t>Iwe Jehova we di ọku n'aru ndi-Ya,</t> <t>O we kpọ ihe-nketa-Ya ihe-árú.</t>
<t>O we nye ha n'aka mba di iche iche;</t> <t>Ndi nākpọ ha asì we nāchi ha.</t>
<t>Ndi-iro-ha meb͕u-kwa-ra ha,</t> <t>Ewe me ka ha ruru ala n'okpuru aka-ha.</t>
<t>Ọtutu mb͕e ka Ọ nanaputa ha;</t> <t>Ma ha onwe-ha nānupu isi n'okpuru Chineke na ndum-ọdu-ha,</t> <t>Ewe kwada ha n'ajọ omume-ha.</t>
<t>O we lekwasi ahuhu diri ha anya,</t> <t>Mb͕e Ọ nuru iti-nkpu-ha:</t>
<t>O we cheta ọb͕ub͕a-ndu-Ya nye ha,</t> <t>We chègharia dika iba-uba nke ebere-Ya nile si di.</t>
<t>O we me ha ka enwe obi-ebere nile n'aru ha</t> <t>N'iru ndi nile ndi nādọta ha n'agha.</t>
<t>Zọputa ayi, Jehova, bú Chineke-ayi,</t> <t>Chikọputa kwa ayi n'etiti mba nile</t> <t>Ikele aha nsọ Gi,</t> <t>Na inya isi n'otuto-Gi. <pb/></t>
<t>Onye agọziri agọzi ka Jehova, bú Chineke nke Israel, bu,</t> <t>Site na mb͕e ebighi-ebi we rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi.</t> <t>Ka ndi Israel nile si kwa, Amen.</t> <t>Tonu Ja.</t>
